description: This file contains unit tests for struct alignment and padding in C++, including compile-time assertions and runtime tests for struct member offsets and alignments, specifically for structures with ascending and descending data type sizes, nested structs, and unions.

methods.name: SbSabiStructAlignmentTest.AscendingDataTypeSizes
methods.description: Tests the offsets and values of a struct with ascending data type sizes.

methods.name: SbSabiStructAlignmentTest.DescendingDataTypeSizes
methods.description: Tests the offsets and values of a struct with descending data type sizes.

methods.name: SbSabiStructAlignmentTest.NestedStruct
methods.description: Tests the offsets and values of a nested struct.

methods.name: SbSabiStructAlignmentTest.NestedUnion
methods.description: Tests the offsets and values of a struct with a nested union.
